thread:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — ClearHarbor wants final onboarding acceptance docs for SLAs before renewal call. They specifically asked for uptime evidence (99.9% target), p95 latency snapshots for the last 30 days, and the credit calculation example if we missed thresholds. Can ops/sre pull artifacts and propose a short customer-facing one-pager?

Aiden (Ops): On it. I'll grab uptime rollups + incident list from our dashboard. Which 30-day window do we want? last calendar month or trailing 30 days?

Maya (CSM): Trailing 30 days is safest for them. Also include any maintenance windows that were excluded from SLA.

Priya (SRE): Will run the p95 queries and produce both raw histogram and a summarized table. Also will check KV-cache hit rates — sometimes tail latency spikes correlate. I can include flamegraphs for a sample high-p95 window.

Tom (Support): I'll export the ticket thread IDs related to latency incidents and link them. Might be useful for context in the one-pager (root cause + mitigation).

Aiden (Ops): Quick note: our uptime metric = healthy_request_count / total_request_count after scheduled windows excluded. I'll attach the Prometheus query and metrics export.

Priya (SRE): Prom query I'm using: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job))``` Will run aggregated by model-route. Anything else?

Maya (CSM): Good. Can you include a small example credit calc? e.g., if uptime = 99.6% over period, show the prorated credit per contract terms for a $25k monthly commit. Keeps it concrete for procurement.

Aiden (Ops): I can mock that calc. Example we use in past: uptime deficit = 99.9 - observed_uptime; credit_pct = min(1.0, deficit * factor) — I’ll convert to dollar example.

Priya (SRE): One more ask: please confirm whether any canary rollouts or model fallbacks were triggered -> impacts observed latency. I'll grep deploy logs for rollout timestamps. DeployBot: new deploy events will be pasted here.

DeployBot: deploy/infra-service v2.14.1 started 2025-11-12T03:12Z, completed 2025-11-12T03:22Z :package: (no rollback)

Maya (CSM): Thanks — include that deploy in the timeline if it aligns with any latency blips.

Tom (Support): FYI I found tickets #CH-1124 and #CH-1140 flagged by the customer; both during high tail latency days. I'll link excerpts.

Aiden (Ops): I'm exporting: uptime_csv and incident_list.zip -> uploading to the shared folder now. Link: https://redwood.internal/clearharbor/sla-pack-1897654320

Priya (SRE): Uploaded p95_table.csv and flamegraph-sample.svg to the same folder. Ran a quick KV-hit correlation and saw 3 low-hit windows corresponding to p95 spikes.

Maya (CSM): Amazing. I'll draft the one-pager: 1) SLA status (numbers), 2) timeline (deploys/incidents), 3) root causes + mitigations, 4) example credit calc, 5) recommended next steps. Will share draft for review.

Tom (Support): Happy to proof and add ticket quotes.

Priya (SRE): Quick suggestion for the one-pager: add a short blurb on how we measure latency per-route and how caching/quantization profiles affect p95 so they understand levers.

Maya (CSM): Good call. Target to have draft by EOD PT tomorrow. Anyone not available?

Aiden (Ops): available, will review.

Tom (Support): available.

Priya (SRE): available.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll ping the customer with a short note that we're compiling the pack and will send the one-pager + evidence link tomorrow. :thumbsup:
